title: Build While You Wait
kicker: Keep building while a change waits
tagline: While one change waits to go live, the next one gets built on top of it.
what: Every task gets its own sandbox: its own copy of the code and its own copy of the data. When a change is stuck waiting to go live, the next piece gets built on top of it instead of everyone sitting idle.
built: Every change gets its own sandbox, with its own copy of the code and the data
When a change is held, the next piece starts from that exact point instead of waiting
Each piece on top gets its own review and full test run while the hold stands
The whole pile goes live once the held change is live
credit: Built it on top of my own tools
starring: Every AI chat with a change in line

making.problem: Every time a change waited for the timetable that takes changes live (the deploy train), the chat that built it just sat there until it went live.

moment.what: When a change is held up, I no longer wait. The next pieces get built, reviewed and tested on top of it, ready to go live the moment it does.

frames.name: Held
frames.says: Sometimes a finished change has to wait before it can go live.

frames.name: Build on top
frames.says: The next piece starts from the waiting change and gets its own review and full tests.

frames.name: All go live
frames.says: Once the waiting change is live, everything built on top of it follows.
